name: papermanager
description: PaperManager — 极简 macOS 学术论文管理器

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && bun run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.build:electron: bun build electron/main.ts --outdir dist-electron --target node --format cjs --external electron --external pdfjs-dist && bun build electron/preload.ts --outdir dist-electron --target node --format cjs --external electron
